_comment: Special conditions that have NO public hostname and are never part of the deployable handler. Google /sorry/ is a protocol-level fixture only (the exact URL, status and body text a classifier receives); no owned page imitates it and no browser visits it. Proxy failures are browser-transport fixtures produced by a local gateway; Chromium shows them at chrome-error://chromewebdata/. The YouTube account gate is a normal lane: /scenario/youtube-account-gate/{token} on the parent origin.

googleRateLimit.text: Our systems have detected unusual traffic from your computer network.

youtubeGate.text: Sign in to confirm you're not a bot

proxy_auth_407.description: Local gateway answers every CONNECT with 407 Proxy Authentication Required (no credentials are ever supplied)

tunnel_502.description: Local gateway answers every request and CONNECT with 502 Bad Gateway

proxy_unreachable.description: Browser is pointed at a loopback proxy port with nothing listening

proxyGateway.note: Chromium itself opens background CONNECTs (observed: www.google.com:443) inside a proxied context. They reach only the loopback gateway, which never forwards anything, and are recorded in the gateway log as evidence.
